style: cinematic 3D, Pixar-quality, slapstick, deadpan, hard midday sun
shot: grounded low angle, camera does not move until the final push-in
character: PIG: plump pink pig, deadpan heavy-lidded eyes, blinks slowly, dusty builder's apron; trotters grip/sweep/count/pin
cast: CAT: scruffy grey tabby contractor, work vest, never speaks; large, bigger than pig
props: hammer, piggy bank, coins, blueprint pinned to a stake, cat's black debris bag with a receipt taped on — all on one wooden plank, nothing stacked
setting: yard by an unfinished house, concrete slab

audio.delivery: male low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry unrushed flat deadpan, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: two sentences only, calm even tempo throughout, never rushed, no pause inside either sentence. «строительного»: stroh-EE-tyel-no-vo, stress on the second syllable EE, never on TYEL. Nothing after 7.95
audio.lip_sync: pig talks like a person, mouth opens and closes clearly every syllable, voice is the pig's own, never a voice over
audio.sfx: hammer strike, ceramic shattering, coins clinking, blueprint flapping, bag tearing, gravel pouring, paper pinned

timeline.a: silent. Hammer already mid-downswing, blurred arc cutting a third of the frame; blueprint corner snapping hard behind her
silent. Hammer connects, bank shatters in one burst, shards and coins spray the lower frame, dust kicks up; recoil jolts her half a step back
silent. Hammer drops from her grip, bounces off the plank; last coins rain down, rolling to a stop
calm. Trotters sweep coins into a pile briskly, dust puffing, body rocking with each sweep
calm, no pause. Last sweep finishes the pile in a puff of dust, snout snaps up toward the blueprint
silent. Counts coins loud, trotter slamming on each one, tail whipping; last coin gets a lighter tap, slam easing off, brow furrows
silent. Cat lands hard from the right, shoulder bumps hers, jolting her sideways a step; sets a black debris bag beside the coins
silent. Cat rips the bag open, upends it over the coins — half its gravel and dust spill in
calm. Grabs the open bag, hefts it off the plank, straining
calm, no pause. Peers into the bag, snout wrinkling; cat yanks the bag hard, lurching it
calm, no pause. Bag still lurching, trotters lock hard onto the corner, gravel scraping inside
calm, no pause. Bag lifted, gravel sifting from a hole
silent. Cat jabs a claw at a receipt taped to the bag, staring at her; her ear flicks once
silent. Pulls the blueprint off the stake, pins it over the bag, covering the receipt; turns to camera
silent. Turn completes into a steady stance facing lens, weight rocking faintly hoof to hoof; snout jabs once at the scattered gravel, pointless now
timeline.cam: only camera move in the clip: slow push-in on her face, ending the shot

must_appear: hammer shattering the piggy bank; coins piled then counted; cat landing, bumping her shoulder; bag upended over the coins, gravel mixing in; receipt taped to the bag; blueprint moved to bag; final push-in
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dim, moody, low key, lamp, dark scene, underexposed; human hands; extra pigs, cats; duplicate hammer, bag, or blueprint, a second intact piggy bank; floating objects, props stacked in tiers; camera movement besides the push-in; cuts, jump cuts; extra limbs; costume changes; frozen pose, motionless hold; slow speech, rushed delivery, drawn-out delivery, pauses mid-sentence, speech after 7.95, foreign accent, English speech; subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, readable text
